claim_text: Pregnancy is a context in which concentrated turmeric/curcumin supplements should not be assumed safe; culinary use and concentrated supplements are not equivalent, and evidence is insufficient to recommend medicinal-dose use during pregnancy.
health_goal_or_outcome: Identify safety constraints and prevent unsupported supplement recommendations.
ingredient_form_or_preparation: Supplement products; verify exact formulation, concentration and label.
evidence_summary: NCCIH turmeric resources describe safety uncertainties and advise caution in pregnancy for supplements.
limitations: No dose; refer to obstetric clinician and exact product information.
Exact source passages, product-specific labeling and clinical applicability require full appraisal.
